shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'waits for server sockets|wsTestSupport|validated by.*wsTestSupport|tests_covering|specs/' specs adrs .lore/test-commands.yml scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'stopEngines|stopLocalEngines|\\.cache/mongodb|MongoMemory' src/transport src/infrastructure/stores/mongo jest.config.* && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null && git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls -ld node_modules/.cache node_modules/.cache/mongodb-binaries 2>&1; sed -n '180,235p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md; rg -n 'close|stop|tear|socket' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | tail -25; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "test -d node_modules && echo present || echo missing; sed -n '1,100p' jest.config.js; rg -n 'mongodb-binaries|MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_DIR|downloadDir' .github scripts package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; sed -n '1,140p' src/transport/ws/connectionHandler.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'stop:|async stop|function stop' src/transport/createServer.ts; sed -n '100,180p' src/transport/createServer.ts; sed -n '1,90p' src/transport/sessionSurvivesClose.test.ts; sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,55p' src/transport/createServer.ts; sed -n '107,135p' src/transport/createServer.ts; rg -n 'stop\\(\\)|stop:|shutting down|server stop' src/transport/*.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'spec anchor|specAnchor|spec:' src/transport/*.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/lore-run-test.mjs | head -65; rg -n 'serverStop|wsTestSupport.test' specs adrs src 2>/dev/null; git diff --stat; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/infrastructure/stores/mongo/mongoTestSupport.ts .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/transport/serverStop.test.ts | head -18 && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/infrastructure/stores/mongo/mongoTestSupport.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/serverStop.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.test.ts && git commit -m 'Wait for sockets to close on server stop'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
